blocks.text: BEIJING–China’s Zheng Qinwen pulled off another three-set victory to dispatch Alina Charaeva 6-1, 2-6, 6-4, in the China Open fourth round. Zheng, the current world number 54, will face Ukraine’s Elina Svitolina, the sixth seed, in the quarterfinal.
